items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that localizing a site twice along a morphism of the site gives a commutative diagram of continuous and cocontinuous functors whose associated diagram of topoi is commutative, with the induced functor identified with the localization in the induced object, and with the expected identities for the lower shriek, the pullback and the pushforward (statement lines 5671-5692). The proof is a short argument: the commutativity of the diagram of site functors is immediate and the identification of the induced functor follows from the definitions (proof lines 5695-5696); the companion result on composition gives the commutative diagram of topoi (proof lines 5697-5709), from which the identities for the pullback and pushforward follow, and the identity for the lower shriek follows from adjointness (proof lines 5710-5712). The non-formal content is the identification of the induced functor. The claim is H1: a short derivation with each input named.
